text: I feel as though I have entered a space dedicated to curiosity and innovation. The glass walls are a silent threshold separating the world outside from the concentrated purpose of the interior. Inside, a wall reminds me of the value of research and development. There is a sense of anticipation—here, ideas are not just discussed but brought to life. The colors and lights evoke energy and movement, yet the environment also asks for contemplation. I feel eager to engage, to read, to interact, and to reflect on the future that is imagined and constructed within spaces like this.
